content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: in session S4f6ead43, each Save click (599 at 12457 ms, 661 at 14374 ms) is followed within about 5-8 ms by a visible validation error (600:e623, 663:e689), and the edits made between attempts (Customer 604/606, Payment Due Date 665/667) are not followed by a cleared error. This suggests Save validates a field the user did not change, possibly Warehouse, which received focus (580) with no input_activity before the first Save.", "fix": "Fix: On the sales invoice:new Save button handler, when validation fails, move focus to the first invalid field (for example the Warehouse combobox) and show its error message inline beside that field, instead of the generic visible error that appears at the top of the form.", "cited_event_ids": ["599", "600:e623", "661", "663:e689", "580", "604", "606", "665", "667"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The text of the validation error and which field it refers to are not in the events; 'visible' only gives the error type.", "Warehouse as the invalid field is an inference from focus without input, not a confirmed validation rule.", "Whether the error element is at the top of the form or on the Save button is not shown in the events.", "Behaviour in sessions Se8131012 and Sab8e6b94 is not cited here, though they show the same Save-error loop pattern.", "The events do not show why the user left the form at 18842 ms (navigation to customer:list); the abandonment outcome comes from the insight facts only.", "Dropped pointer samples (486 in S4f6ead43) limit the detail of the pointer trail."]}
